posts.cooked:
Rampant speculation on what they are.

 

Absolute Zero is fairly easy:

Until end of next turn all damage done by Absolute Zero is increased by 2


Bunker takes a bit of guess work. My take:

Destroy 1 of your ongoing or equipment cards.  If you do, draw or play 1 card, and use a power in any order.

It could be draw AND play 1 card, and use a power but that seems a bit too strong.

Unity is kind of weird, as best I can guess:

Play (destroy maybe?) a mechanical golem, then  (search) (  ) (   ) your deck,  move a  mechanical golem from your trash into your hand. You may draw a card.

There doesn't seem to be a lot of room in the text box to contain all the words it needs to search up a golem and put it anywhere in that one line of text.   The abilities together seem a bit disjointed.   Any suggestions?
